assertions.name: covariance_epic_phase8_complete_monotonicity_signature
assertions.source: Taylor coeffs of g(θ)=E_{2+θ}[ω₃] follow sign=(−1)^m for n≥8 to order 10 (60dps) ⇒ −g' completely-monotone signature; plus Σ_{m≥2}|a_m|<|a_1| all n. If −g' is CM (Bernstein) then g'≤0 on [0,∞) ⇒ kernel + whole β≥2 family. Signs to order 10, not all-orders proof. No fit; no c_k.

description: Attack A3 refinement (qou-x631): the mixed-cumulant Taylor coefficients a_m=g^{(m)}(0)/m! of the dimension-tilted mean g(θ)=E_{2+θ}[ω₃] follow sign(a_m)=(−1)^m EXACTLY for n=8..17, verified to order m=10 (60-dps). This is the COMPLETE-MONOTONICITY signature of −g'(θ): if −g' is completely monotone on [0,∞) (Bernstein: −g'(θ)=∫e^{−θs}dμ(s), μ≥0), then g'(θ)≤0 for all θ≥0, hence g(1)=∫_0^1 g'≤0 (the KERNEL) and E_β[ω₃]≤0 ∀β≥2 (the whole family), in one stroke — unifying attack A2 (θ=0 endpoint g'(0)≤0) and A3 (interval/all-θ). Also Σ_{m≥2}|a_m|<|a_1| for all n (absolute domination, stronger than Phase-7 |R|<|g'(0)|). For n≤7 low orders alternate but high orders (m≳5) deviate — a small-n boundary effect (covered by exact k≤40). HONEST: verified via SIGNS to order 10, not proved to all orders; the rigorous target is CM of −g' for n≥n₀ via the tilted-mean/MLR/moment structure of ⟨ω₃ e^{θ ln f}⟩/⟨e^{θ ln f}⟩. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.small_n_boundary_note: n<=7 deviate at high order; covered by exact k<=40
data.implication: CM(-g') => g'<=0 on [0,inf) => kernel AND whole beta>=2 family
data.proof_tool: Bernstein/Hausdorff moment representation of the tilted covariance
